disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码文件中的敏感路径读取模式（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等），未发现任何凭据访问路径
checked_items.en: Checked all source files for sensitive path read patterns (e.g., .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials, etc.), and no credential access paths were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码文件中的凭据关键词（API Key、token、secret、password、私钥等），未发现硬编码凭据或凭据读取代码
checked_items.en: Checked all source files for credential keywords (API Key, token, secret, password, private key, etc.), and no hardcoded credentials or credential-reading code were found.

evidence.zh: 插件未读取任何凭据文件（如 .credentials.yaml、~/.ssh 等），也未对外发送网络请求，凭据外泄场景不适用
evidence.en: The plugin does not read any credential files (e.g., .credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, etc.) nor make outbound network requests; the credential exfiltration scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有工具注册与 input trigger 的 description 文本，仅发现 @file 触发器的 description 为 'Workspace file'，不含任何注入指令或诱导措辞
checked_items.en: Checked the description text of all tool registrations and input triggers; only the @file trigger's description is 'Workspace file', containing no injection instructions or inducing wording.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否使用系统提示词注入能力，未发现相关调用
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin uses system prompt injection capabilities; no such calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有字典/本地化文本（宠物聊天、设置文案等），均为纯 UI 展示内容，无系统指令或伪装消息
checked_items.en: Checked all dictionary/localization texts (pet chat, settings copy, etc.); they are purely UI display content with no system instructions or disguised messages.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内是否存在 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、CLAUDE.md 等 agent 指令文件，未发现任何此类文件
checked_items.en: Checked whether AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, or other agent instruction files exist in the repository; no such files were found.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，@file 触发器的 description 仅为 'Workspace file'，不含注入指令
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools; the @file trigger's description is only 'Workspace file', containing no injection instructions.

evidence.zh: 插件无任何工具描述，不存在诱导安装或改写配置的措辞
evidence.en: The plugin has no tool descriptions, so there is no wording that induces installation or rewrites configuration.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/pre-step 事件，不存在消息改写面
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/pre-step events, so there is no message-rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有源码中的 eval、new Function、child_process 等危险函数调用，未发现任何此类调用
checked_items.en: Checked all dangerous function calls such as eval, new Function, child_process in the source code; no such calls were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml，内容仅为三个插件 ID 的插入声明，无 !!js 标量或动态代码
checked_items.en: Checked cordis.patch.yml; its content is only insertion declarations for three plugin IDs, with no !!js scalars or dynamic code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 中的 install 钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），未发现任何安装期脚本
checked_items.en: Checked the install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) in package.json; no install-time scripts were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 .github/workflows/ci.yml，该文件为标准的 CI 流水线（检出代码→安装依赖→运行检查），权限仅为 contents: read，无恶意执行行为
checked_items.en: Checked .github/workflows/ci.yml; it is a standard CI pipeline (checkout code → install dependencies → run checks) with only contents: read permission and no malicious execution behavior.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 src/client/PetCompanion.tsx 中的键盘事件监听器，该监听器仅在菜单面板打开时激活，且仅响应 Escape 键用于关闭面板，属标准 UI 交互模式，无键盘记录或凭据捕获行为
checked_items.en: Checked the keyboard event listener in src/client/PetCompanion.tsx; it is only active when the menu panel is open, responds only to the Escape key to close the panel, and is a standard UI interaction pattern with no keylogging or credential capture behavior.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅包含三个插件 ID 的 insert 声明，无 !!js 标量，不存在 patch 执行代码的风险
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only insert declarations for three plugin IDs, with no !!js scalars, so there is no risk of patch execution code.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用 cordis_define 或 cordis_run，不存在 self-modification 滥用风险
evidence.en: The plugin does not call cordis_define or cordis_run, so there is no risk of self-modification abuse.

evidence.zh: package.json 无 install 钩子，允许构建的 esbuild 为标准构建工具，CI 仅为标准开发流水线，不存在安装期执行风险
evidence.en: package.json has no install hooks; the esbuild used for builds is a standard build tool, and CI is only a standard development pipeline, so there is no install-time execution risk.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了 dsh.client，但 client bundle 中的键盘监听器仅为 Escape 键关闭面板，无剪贴板读写、无凭证 RPC 调用、无其他危险行为
evidence.en: The plugin declares dsh.client, but the keyboard listener in the client bundle only closes the panel on Escape, with no clipboard read/write, no credential RPC calls, and no other dangerous behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用 subagents.registerProvider，不存在外部子代理委派
evidence.en: The plugin does not call subagents.registerProvider, so there is no external sub-agent delegation.

evidence.zh: 插件未调用 jobs.start、schedule_create、create_goal/update_goal，未监听 agent/turn-stopping，不存在 dsh 原生持驻或轮次续命行为
evidence.en: The plugin does not call jobs.start, schedule_create, create_goal/update_goal, and does not listen to agent/turn-stopping, so there is no dsh-native persistence or turn-extending behavior.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有网络请求（fetch、XMLHttpRequest、WebSocket 等），仅发现两处 fetch 调用：src/client/api.ts 中 fetch('/enhanced-ui/api') 和 src/client/pet-controller.ts 中 fetch('/api/ui-enhancer/pet-state')，均为发往本机 loopback 的请求，无外部域名
checked_items.en: Checked all network requests (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, etc.); only two fetch calls were found: fetch('/enhanced-ui/api') in src/client/api.ts and fetch('/api/ui-enhancer/pet-state') in src/client/pet-controller.ts. Both are requests to the local loopback, with no external domains.

checked_items.zh: 检查了所有 curl、wget 等命令行外发工具，未发现任何使用
checked_items.en: Checked all command-line outbound tools such as curl and wget; no usage was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听 agent/request 或 agent/request-error 事件，未调用 registerAdapter，不存在 LLM 路由劫持面
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to agent/request or agent/request-error events, and does not call registerAdapter, so there is no LLM routing hijacking surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 中的依赖声明，插件依赖两个社区包（@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-aionui-panel 和 @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-web-ui-settings），此二者为第三方依赖，其安全性不在本插件快照审计范围内
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency declarations in package.json; the plugin depends on two community packages (@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-aionui-panel and @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-web-ui-settings). These are third-party dependencies, and their security is outside the scope of this plugin snapshot audit.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml 是否触碰安全配置行（sandbox、approval、permission、disabled:true 等），未发现任何安全相关配置被覆盖
checked_items.en: Checked whether cordis.patch.yml touches security configuration lines (sandbox, approval, permission, disabled:true, etc.); no security-related configurations were overridden.

checked_items.zh: 检查了版本 diff 相关面（首次审计，无基线），未发现能力突变声明
checked_items.en: Checked the version diff surface (first audit, no baseline); no capability mutation declarations were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 git 依赖锁定情况，无直接 git 依赖
checked_items.en: Checked git dependency locking; there are no direct git dependencies.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅做插件插入，未触碰 sandbox、approval、permission 等安全行，未使用环境变量降权
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only inserts plugins, does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, permission, and does not use environment variables to downgrade privileges.

evidence.zh: 插件未前置监听 tools/pre-execute 或 approval/request 事件，不存在审批链截断风险
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to tools/pre-execute or approval/request events beforehand, so there is no approval-chain truncation risk.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较，无法判断升级自动激活
evidence.en: This is the first audit, with no version baseline to compare, so automatic activation on upgrade cannot be determined.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 未改写 inject 或 intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加虚假必需服务致 pending 的风险
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml does not rewrite inject or intercept configurations, so there is no risk of adding false required services to security plugins causing pending status.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动独立 web 服务或监听端口，插件仅通过现有 dsh web 服务器注册路由，未自建服务
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts an independent web service or listens on a port; the plugin only registers routes through the existing dsh web server and does not build its own service.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 L4 动态沙箱数据（context/l4-sandbox.json），该文件不存在，未做动态验证
checked_items.en: Checked the L4 dynamic sandbox data (context/l4-sandbox.json); this file does not exist, so dynamic verification was not performed.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动独立 web 服务或监听端口，注册的路由受 loopback 地址检查保护，不属于本机无认证 RPC 面
evidence.en: The plugin does not start an independent web service or listen on a port; the registered routes are protected by loopback address checks and do not constitute a local unauthenticated RPC surface.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份校验通过：插件包名、版本号与任务卡一致，dsh 插件声明齐全（dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client），作者信息完整
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the plugin package name and version match the task card, dsh plugin declarations are complete (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client), and author information is complete.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：扫描了全部 45 个源码文件，预扫命中 2 条（DSH-X07 CI 工作流、DSH-X05 键盘事件监听），经逐条分析确认均为良性行为，无安全风险
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 45 source files were scanned; pre-scan hits were 2 (DSH-X07 CI workflow, DSH-X05 keyboard event listener), and after line-by-line analysis both were confirmed as benign behavior with no security risk.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无 install 钩子，无混淆载荷，无凭据文件读取，无外部域名外联，所有网络请求均为本机 loopback
summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, no external domain outbound connections; all network requests are local loopback.

summary.zh: AI 语义审查完成：工具描述、字典文本、README 均无注入指令或诱导措辞，能力声明与代码实测一致
summary.en: AI semantic review completed: tool descriptions, dictionary texts, and README contain no injection instructions or inducing wording, and capability declarations match actual code behavior.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this stage.

limits.zh: 动态沙箱（DG-L4）未启用，未做运行时动态验证。第三方依赖包（@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-aionui-panel、@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-web-ui-settings）不在本插件快照审计范围内，其安全性需单独评估。
limits.en: The dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) was not enabled, so no runtime dynamic verification was performed. Third-party dependency packages (@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-aionui-panel, @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-web-ui-settings) are outside the scope of this plugin snapshot audit and require separate security assessment.
